title: Stage.3
summary: A publishing platform and launch system helping ambitious games find their audience and build momentum beyond launch.
body:
### Publishing beyond launch

Stage.3 brings together audience discovery, game positioning, and launch systems to help game teams reach players and sustain momentum.

Its approach is built around three connected stages:

- **Ignition:** Clarify the message and identify the right audience.
- **Thrust:** Build a recognizable world around the game that players can discover and share.
- **Escape:** Establish launch systems that continue supporting the game after release.
